topic: Programs that run git themselves (accepted risk, D-60)
detail: Accepted under D-60 and RC-117, recorded by the SP-044 security reviews of 2026-11-14: gh pushing an unpushed head branch itself (its interactive prompt), external git-<name> subcommands on PATH (git town, git-spr) that an alias check finds no alias for, gh's interactive base-repo prompt for a fork under a PTY (Codex exec_command with a tty), and gh api --hostname or -R naming another host. The check does not read what these send; SP-045's git hooks and per-job accounts are the boundary.
